name: Bastion
description: Halves incoming damage when the opponent has higher Initiative.

effects.description: If the opponent has higher initiative, or is a monster, when you Take Damage, half it (rounding up).

name: Fairy
description: Gains Enchanted Attack dice from matching origins when awakened, plus 3 Initiative.

effects.description: When Awakened, gain 1 Enchanted Attack for every spirit matching this Fairy's origin. Gain 3 Initiative.

name: Ram
description: Deals more combat damage for each Spirit Augment on your spirits.

effects.description: In combat, deal 1 more damage for each Spirit Augment on your spirits.

name: King
description: Gains VP during Awakening, but must be discarded while Evil.

effects.description: In the Awakening Phase, Gain 1 VP. If you are evil, you must discard this spirit.

name: Battle Adept
description: Gains Max Barrier from overkills.

effects.description: If you overkill by 2 damage, gain 1 Max Barrier.

name: Queen
description: Gains VP during the Awakening Phase.

effects.description: In the Awakening Phase, gain 1 VP.

name: Warden
description: Reduces incoming damage for each Water Spirit.

effects.description: When you Take Damage, take 1 less for every Water Spirit.

name: Fighter
description: Adds combat Initiative for each Fighter trait (up to 5) and gains Basic Attack dice when you Rest. Higher trait counts grant more dice and a Spirit Augment.

effects.description: In combat, gain 1 combat initiative.
In combat, gain 2 combat initiative. On Rest, gain 1 Basic Attack Dice.
In combat, gain 3 combat initiative. On Rest, gain 2 Basic Attack Dice.
In combat, gain 4 combat initiative. On Rest, gain 3 Basic Attack Dice.
In combat, gain 5 combat initiative. On Rest, gain 5 Basic Attack Dice and 1 of any spirit augment.

footer_translations.de: Erwarteter Wurf der Nahkampfangriffswürfel: ~1, geringe Varianz.
footer_translations.es: Tirada esperada de los dados de ataque cuerpo a cuerpo: ~1, baja varianza.
footer_translations.fr: Jet attendu des dés d’attaque au corps à corps : ~1, faible variance.
footer_translations.it: Tiro atteso dei dadi d’attacco in mischia: ~1, bassa varianza.
footer_translations.ja: 近接攻撃ダイスの期待値：~1、低分散。
footer_translations.ko: 근접 공격 주사위 기대값: ~1, 낮은 분산.
footer_translations.pl: Oczekiwany wynik rzutu kośćmi ataku wręcz: ~1, niska wariancja.
footer_translations.zh-Hans: 近战攻击骰子期望掷出值：约1，低方差。
footer_translations.zh-Hant: 近戰攻擊骰的預期擲骰結果：~1，低變異。

name: Elementalist
description: Upgrades attack dice (Basic to Enchanted to Exalted) as you play. More Elementalists unlock more ways to upgrade.

effects.description: On Rest, upgrade an attack dice.
On Rest, upgrade an attack dice 2 times.
On Rest, upgrade an attack dice 3 times.
On Rest, upgrade an attack dice 5 times if you have a relic (any relic); 3 times if you have none.

footer_translations.de: Erwarteter Wurf an Magieangriffswürfeln: 4, hohe Varianz.
footer_translations.es: Tirada esperada de dados de ataque mágico: 4, alta varianza.
footer_translations.fr: Jet attendu de dés d’attaque magique : 4, forte variance.
footer_translations.it: Tiro previsto di dadi d’attacco magico: 4, alta varianza.
footer_translations.ja: 魔法攻撃ダイスの期待ロール数：4、高い分散。
footer_translations.ko: 마법 공격 주사위 기대 굴림: 4, 높은 변동성.
footer_translations.pl: Oczekiwany rzut kośćmi ataku magicznego: 4, wysoka wariancja.
footer_translations.zh-Hans: 魔法攻击骰预期掷骰数：4，高波动。
footer_translations.zh-Hant: 魔法攻擊骰的預期擲骰數：4，波動較大。

name: Nomad
description: Can perform each location interaction up to twice.

effects.description: You may do ALL location interactions up to two times. In the Awakening Phase, gain 1 Any basic Rune.

name: Relic Envoy
description: Shares Fairy Relics with players you encounter.

effects.description: When you encounter a player, you may give them and yourself 1 Fairy Relic from the supply.

name: Relic Sentinel
description: Can discard a relic to prevent incoming damage.

effects.description: When you Take Damage, you may choose to take 0 damage if you discard a relic.

name: Spellblade
description: Can redirect navigation and always attacks first.

effects.description: On Navigation Reveal, you may change your destination and you may always attack first.

name: Mystic
description: Reshapes spirit summons and unlocks doubled Cultivate runes, simultaneous attacks, and additional augment placement.

effects.description: On a Spirit World or Abyss Summon, you may put all spirits back and draw again.
When you Cultivate, you may gain twice as many runes. In addition to (1) and (2).
When gaining spirit augments, you may place them on a spirit with one existing augment. In addition to (1), (2) and (3).
In combat with a monster, you may always attack at the same time as the monster. In addition to (1).

name: Cursed Spirit
description: Grants Awakening rewards based on your corruption status and Cursed Spirit traits.

effects.description: If you become Tainted, in the Awakening Phase, gain 1 max barrier or 1 Basic Attack for every Cursed Spirit.
If you become Corrupt,  in the Awakening Phase, gain 1 max barrier or 1 Rune for every Cursed Spirit.
If you become Fallen, in the Awakening Phase, gain 1 max barrier or 1 Spirit Augment for every Cursed Spirit.

name: Druid
description: Gains one more Exalted Attack Dice when you gain one.

effects.description: When you gain an Exalted Attack Dice, you may gain 1 more. The extra dice does not cause this ability again.

name: Titan
description: Has +6 damage and +6 Initiative, and reduces incoming damage by 6.

effects.description: When you take damage, take 6 less. Gain 6 damage and 6 Initiative.

name: Sentinel
description: Can discard attack dice before the roll to deal more damage.

effects.description: Before you roll in combat, you may discard attack dice. For each dice that you discard, deal 2 more damage.

name: Sorcerer
description: Gains an Enchanted Attack Dice in the Awakening Phase while you are Evil.

effects.description: In the Awakening Phase, if you are Evil, gain 1 Enchanted Attack Dice.

name: Cultivator
description: Gains Max Barrier when you Cultivate. Higher trait counts grant more capacity and a relic.

effects.description: On Cultivate, gain 1 Max Barrier.
On Cultivate, gain 2 Max Barrier.
On Cultivate, gain 3 Max Barrier.
On Cultivate, gain 5 Max Barrier. The first time (once per game), also gain 1 relic of your choice.

name: Monk
description: Gains Initiative and takes less damage while you are not Evil and have no Cursed Spirits.

effects.description: While you are not Evil and have no Cursed Spirits, gain 3 Initiative and take 2 less damage.

name: Herder
description: Lets each of your Arcane spirits hold two Spirit Augments.

effects.description: Each of your Arcane spirits may hold up to 2 Spirit Augments.

name: Arcane Alchemist
description: Converts four attack dice into an Arcane Attack die when you Cultivate.

effects.description: When you cultivate, you may discard 4 attack dice to gain 1 Arcane Attack Dice.

name: Smith
description: Gains one more Spirit Augment when you gain one.

effects.description: When you gain a Spirit Augment, you may gain 1 more of your choice. The extra augment does not cause this ability again.

name: Huntress
description: Has +2 Initiative and gains three Arcane Attack dice when awakened.

effects.description: Gain 2 initiative. On this spirit's Awakening, gain 3 Arcane Attack Dice.

name: Mage
description: Gains 4 Arcane Attack Dice when awakened.

effects.description: On this spirit's Awakening, gain 4 Arcane Attack Dice.

name: Corruptor
description: Sets your status to Fallen and transforms Spirit World spirits into Arcane Abyss spirits.

effects.description: Set your status to Fallen (this is not a corruption). Replace all Spirit World spirits with a random Arcane Abyss Spirit. Gain 2 Initiative.

name: Woundreaver
description: Deals extra combat damage from broken barriers, up to 4.

effects.description: In Combat, deal 1 damage per Broken Barrier (max 4)

name: Monster Hunter
description: Can initiate Monster Combat twice.

effects.description: You may initiate Monster Combat two times.

name: Healer
description: Restores barriers when discarded, and can restore barriers and gain VP when resting at 10 Max Barrier.

effects.description: On rest, if you have 10 max barrier, you may restore 3 barrier and gain 1 VP. When discarded, restore 2 barrier.

name: Cleric
description: Reduces incoming damage for each unique relic you hold.

effects.description: On this spirit's Awakening, gain 1 relic of your choice. For every unique Relic you hold, reduce incoming damage by 2.

name: Paladin
description: Gains Initiative, and wins initiative ties.

effects.description: +2 Initiative. If initiative is tied, your side strikes first.

name: Beast
description: Adds combat damage for each Spirit Animal trait.

effects.description: In combat, deal 1 damage for every Spirit Animal trait.

description_translations.de: Erhalte 1 zusätzlichen Siegpunkt beim Töten eines Monsters. Verringere eingehenden Monsterschaden um 1
description_translations.es: Gana 1 punto de victoria adicional al matar a un monstruo. Reduce el daño de monstruo recibido en 1
description_translations.fr: Gagnez 1 point de victoire supplémentaire lors de l'élimination d'un monstre. Réduisez les dégâts de monstre subis de 1
description_translations.it: Ottieni 1 punto vittoria extra quando uccidi un Mostro. Riduci di 1 i danni dei mostri subiti
description_translations.ja: モンスターを倒したとき、追加で勝利点を1獲得する。受けるモンスターのダメージを1減らす
description_translations.ko: 몬스터 처치 시 추가로 승리 점수 1점을 획득한다. 받는 몬스터 피해를 1 감소시킨다
description_translations.pl: Zyskaj 1 dodatkowy punkt zwycięstwa za Zabicie Potwora. Zmniejsz otrzymywane obrażenia od potworów o 1
description_translations.zh-Hans: 击杀怪物时额外获得 1 点胜利点数。受到的怪物伤害减少 1
description_translations.zh-Hant: 擊殺怪物時額外獲得 1 點勝利點數。受到的怪物傷害減少 1

name: Sharpshooter
description: Lets your side attack simultaneously with the enemy; grants an Enchanted Attack when discarded.

effects.description: Your side may always attack at the same time as the enemy. When discarded, gain 1 Enchanted Attack.

name: Captain
description: Gains a Spirit Augment when cultivating with three Heroes, and an Enchanted Attack when discarded.

effects.description: If you Cultivate with 3 Heroes, gain 1 Spirit Augment. When discarded, gain 1 Enchanted Attack.

name: Summoner
description: Draws from the Arcane Abyss on Spirit World summons and gains VP for discarded Arcane Abyss spirits.

effects.description: On Spirit World summon, you may draw from the Arcane Abyss Bag. When you discard an Arcane Abyss Spirit, gain 4 points.

description_translations.de: Erhalte 1 Arkaner Angriff für je 2 Arkane Tropfen, die du hast.
description_translations.es: Obtén 1 Ataque Arcano por cada 2 Gotas Arcanas que tengas.
description_translations.fr: Gagnez 1 Attaque arcanique pour chaque tranche de 2 Gouttelettes arcaniques que vous avez.
description_translations.it: Ottieni 1 Attacco Arcano per ogni 2 Gocce Arcane che possiedi.
description_translations.ja: 所持している秘術の雫2つごとに、秘術攻撃を1得る。
description_translations.ko: 보유한 비전 물방울 2개마다 비전 공격 1을 획득합니다.
description_translations.pl: Zyskaj 1 Atak Arkaniczny za każde 2 Arkane Krople, które posiadasz.
description_translations.zh-Hans: 你每拥有 2 个奥术水滴，获得 1 点奥术攻击。
description_translations.zh-Hant: 你每擁有 2 個奧術水滴，獲得 1 點奧術攻擊。

name: Assassin
description: Strikes first and harder against a player who has more attack dice.

effects.description: In combat with a player who has more attack dice than you, strike first and deal 3 more damage.

name: Falconer
description: Doubles the rewards of one monster kill, then leaves.

effects.description: On your next monster kill you may gain double the rewards. Then discard this spirit.

name: Princess
description: Gains VP while you are not Evil and all your spirits are awake.

effects.description: In the Awakening Phase, if you are not Evil and all your spirits are awakened, gain 1 VP.

name: Feral
description: Strikes first and harder against Evil players and monsters.

effects.description: When an Evil player or a monster attacks you, your side strikes first and deals 3 more damage.

name: Trader
description: Your runes can pay as runes of any type.

effects.description: You may pay your runes as runes of any type.

name: Master
description: Gains Max Barrier or restores Barrier when you Cultivate.

effects.description: On Cultivate, gain 2 Max Barrier or restore 2 Barrier.

name: Wildling
description: Gains an Exalted Attack Dice when you gain attack dice.

effects.description: When you gain an attack dice, gain 1 Exalted Attack Dice.

name: Wanderer
description: Gains Basic Attack Dice when you move to a new location.

effects.description: When you enter a location where you were not last round, gain 2 Basic Attack Dice.

name: Prince
description: Deals more damage when you strike first.

effects.description: When you strike first, deal 2 more damage.

name: Hunter
description: Deals more damage in combat with a monster.

effects.description: In combat with a monster, deal 5 more damage.

name: Rider
description: Gains Barrier, Max Barrier, Basic Attack Dice or a Spirit Augment when you arrive at the Mountain Region.

effects.description: When you navigate to the Mountain Region from a different location, choose one: restore 3 Barrier, gain 3 Max Barrier, gain 3 Basic Attack Dice, or gain 1 Spirit Augment of your choice.

name: Salamander
description: Rolls again the attack dice that show 0.

effects.description: In combat, roll again each attack dice that shows 0, once.

name: Firetail
description: Gains Initiative when another player is at your location.

effects.description: In combat with a monster, or in a round when another player is at your location, gain 2 Initiative.

name: Chorus
description: Restores Barrier and gains Max Barrier when you awaken a spirit.

effects.description: When you awaken a spirit (this one included), restore all your Barrier and gain 2 Max Barrier.

name: Witch
description: Takes the best attack dice of a player for one combat.

effects.description: At the start of combat with a player, take the best attack dice of that player for this combat.

name: Cultist
description: Sacrifices fewer spirits and gains VP on corruption.

effects.description: When you become Corrupted, sacrifice 1 fewer spirit and gain 1 VP.

name: Acolyte
description: Restores Barrier when you deal damage to a player.

effects.description: When you deal damage to a player, restore the same quantity of Barrier.

name: Shieldbearer
description: Takes less damage while your Barrier is full.

effects.description: When you take damage, if your Barrier is full, take 5 less.

name: Gardener
description: Restores Barrier in the Awakening Phase while you are not Evil.

effects.description: In the Awakening Phase, if you are not Evil, restore 3 Barrier and gain 1 Max Barrier.
